question: Which of the following cell organelles is made up of ribosomal RNA and protein?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ribosome.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ribosomes **are the **organelles **that are made up of** ribosomal RNA and proteins.**
 
• Ribosomes are responsible for the **synthesis of proteins** in the cell.
 
• Ribosomes can be found in both **prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.**
 
• Ribosomes can be free in the **cytoplasm or attached **to the rough **endoplasmic reticulum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nucleus** is the **organelle** that contains the **genetic material **of the cell and is responsible for** controlling the cell's activities.**
 
• **Golgi body** is responsible for **processing and packaging proteins** and** lipids** that are synthesized in the cell.
 
• **Lysosome** is an **organelle** that contains **digestive enzymes** and is responsible for **breaking down waste materials** in the cell.
